product_overview: رتب شغلك هو تطبيق لإدارة المبيعات والزبائن والمخزون للمحلات التجارية الصغيرة العراقية. يتيح للمستخدمين إدارة الفواتير والديون والمصاريف والتقارير مع نسخ احتياطي واستعادة للبيانات ودعم أوفلاين.
core_goals: إنشاء وإدارة الفواتير وربطها بالزبائن والمنتجات
تسجيل المصاريف وعرض الأرباح والتقارير المالية
نسخ البيانات احتياطياً واستعادتها عند الحاجة
تخصيص إعدادات المتجر مثل العملة وبيانات الملف الشخصي

features.name: تسجيل الدخول وإنشاء الحساب
features.description: تمكين المستخدم من الوصول إلى التطبيق عبر البريد الإلكتروني وكلمة المرور أو عبر حساب Google، مع عرض رسائل الخطأ باللغة العربية.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See dashboard
Navigate to / -> Switch to sign up mode -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit account creation form -> See dashboard
Navigate to / -> Click Google sign-in -> See dashboard
Navigate to / -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form with invalid credentials -> See Arabic error notification

features.name: إدارة الزبائن
features.description: إضافة الزبائن وتعديل بياناتهم وحذفهم وعرض أرصدتهم وديونهم ضمن شاشة إدارة العملاء.
user_flows: Navigate to /?tab=customers -> Add a new customer -> Save customer details -> See customer appear in the list
Navigate to /?tab=customers -> Select an existing customer -> Edit customer details -> Save changes -> See updated customer information
Navigate to /?tab=customers -> Select an existing customer -> Delete customer -> See customer removed from the list
Navigate to /?tab=customers -> View customer balances -> See outstanding balance for each customer

features.name: إدارة المنتجات والمخزون
features.description: إضافة المنتجات وتعديلها وحذفها مع تتبع السعر والكمية والحد الأدنى للمخزون والباركود والتنبيهات الخاصة بالنقص.
user_flows: Navigate to /?tab=products -> Add a product -> Save product details -> See product appear in the inventory list
Navigate to /?tab=products -> Select an existing product -> Edit product details -> Save changes -> See updated product information
Navigate to /?tab=products -> Select an existing product -> Delete product -> See product removed from the list
Navigate to /?tab=products -> See low-stock warnings -> Review products that need replenishment

features.name: إنشاء الفواتير والوصولات
features.description: إنشاء فواتير جديدة وربطها بالزبائن والمنتجات مع احتساب الخصومات والضرائب والمبالغ المدفوعة والمتبقية.
user_flows: Navigate to /?tab=invoices -> Create a new invoice -> Select a customer -> Add line items -> Apply discount -> Apply tax -> Record paid amount -> Save invoice -> See invoice in the list
Navigate to /?tab=invoices -> Create a new invoice -> Select a customer -> Add line items -> Save invoice with partial payment -> See remaining amount recorded as debt
Navigate to /?tab=invoices -> Open an existing invoice -> Print invoice -> See printed copy
Navigate to /?tab=invoices -> Select an invoice -> Delete invoice -> See invoice removed from the list

features.name: الديون والتسديدات
features.description: عرض الديون المستحقة وتسجيل التسديدات المرتبطة بفاتورة محددة أو غير المرتبطة بفاتورة.
user_flows: Navigate to /?tab=debts -> View outstanding debts -> Select a customer debt -> Record a repayment -> See customer balance reduced and invoice remaining amount updated
Navigate to /?tab=debts -> View outstanding debts -> Record a repayment without linking to an invoice -> See customer balance reduced

features.name: المصاريف والأرباح
features.description: تسجيل المصاريف وعرض الحسابات المرتبطة بالربح والفترة المالية الحالية.
user_flows: Navigate to /?tab=expenses -> Add an expense -> Categorize the expense -> Save expense -> See it added to the expense list
Navigate to /?tab=expenses -> View profit calculations -> Review calculated profit values
Navigate to /?tab=expenses -> Filter or review entries by category -> See expenses grouped by category

features.name: التقارير والتحليلات
features.description: عرض ملخصات وتقارير مالية تشمل المبيعات والإيراد الفعلي والمصاريف وصافي الربح مع إمكانية التصفية حسب الفترة.
user_flows: Navigate to /?tab=reports -> View charts and analytics -> See sales, actual revenue, expenses, and net profit
Navigate to /?tab=reports -> Choose a reporting period -> See reports update for the selected period

features.name: النسخ الاحتياطي والاستعادة
features.description: تصدير بيانات العمل للنسخ الاحتياطي واستيرادها للاستعادة مع دعم إعدادات النسخ الاحتياطي التلقائي.
user_flows: Navigate to /?tab=backup -> Export backup data -> Save the backup file
Navigate to /?tab=backup -> Import restore data -> Select a backup file -> Restore business data
Navigate to /?tab=backup -> Configure backup interval -> Save backup schedule

features.name: الإعدادات وتخصيص المتجر
features.description: تعديل ملف المتجر الشخصي وتغيير العملة وسعر الصرف وإعدادات التنبيهات وتفعيل الترخيص.
user_flows: Navigate to /?tab=settings -> Edit store profile details -> Save changes -> See updated store information
Navigate to /?tab=settings -> Switch currency -> Set exchange rate -> Save changes -> See currency settings updated
Navigate to /?tab=settings -> Toggle notification preferences -> Save changes -> See notification settings updated
Navigate to /?tab=settings -> Enter activation code -> Activate license -> See license status updated

features.name: المساعد الذكي للأعمال
features.description: فتح مساعد ذكي بالعربية العراقية وطرح أسئلة تجارية للحصول على ردود تساعد في إدارة المتجر.
user_flows: Navigate to /?tab=advisor -> Open the advisor modal -> Type a business question -> Receive an AI-generated Arabic response -> Close the modal

features.name: النسخة التجريبية وقفل الترخيص
features.description: عرض مدة التجربة المتبقية ثم الانتقال إلى شاشة التفعيل عند انتهاء التجربة.
user_flows: Navigate to /?tab=settings -> See remaining trial days banner -> Click activation prompt -> Go to the activation flow
Navigate to /license-gate -> Enter activation code -> Activate license -> Access the app

tech_stack: Firebase Firestore (persistent local IndexedDB cache, offline support)

routes.description: Login / Sign-up screen (shown when no authenticated user). Email+password and Google sign-in. RTL Arabic UI.
Main dashboard with business KPIs and overview (default tab after login)
Customers/clients management (list, add, edit, delete, balances)
Products & inventory management (stock, prices, low-stock threshold, barcode)
Backup and restore of business data
Settings — store profile, currency (IQD/USD), exchange rate, license activation
AI business advisor modal (Gemini) — Iraqi-dialect business assistant
Owner/admin panel — only visible to the hardcoded ADMIN_UID
License gate shown when the 14-day free trial has expired; blocks app until activated

features.name: Authentication (Email/Password & Google)
features.description: Users sign in or create an account with email+password, or sign in with Google popup. Auth state persists locally via Firebase browserLocalPersistence. Arabic error messages for invalid credentials, weak password, etc.
user_interactions: Toggle between "تسجيل الدخول" (login) and "إنشاء حساب جديد" (sign up) tabs
Fill كلمة المرور (password) input field (min 6 chars)
Click "تسجيل الدخول" / "إنشاء الحساب" submit button (id btn_submit_login)
Click "متابعة عبر حساب غوغل" Google sign-in button (id btn_google_sign_in)
See Arabic error notification (id login_notification) on invalid credentials
Click "نسيت كلمة المرور؟" which shows a "coming soon" notice

features.name: Splash Screen
features.description: Animated splash overlay shown for ~2.5s when transitioning into a logged-in state.
user_interactions: Observe splash animation after successful login

features.name: Dashboard Navigation & Layout
features.description: Tab-based navigation via sidebar (desktop) and bottom nav (mobile). Header shows exchange-rate chip, network/sync status, notifications bell (debts due + low stock), user avatar, trial banner, floating AI advisor button, and logout.
user_interactions: Click sidebar/bottom-nav items to switch tabs
Click notifications bell to open the alerts dropdown
Click a notification to jump to the related tab
Click user avatar to open settings
Click floating bot button to open the AI advisor

features.name: Customers Management
features.description: CRUD for customers/clients including name, phone, address, notes, balance (debt), and due date.

features.name: Products & Inventory
features.description: CRUD for products with buy/sell price, quantity, low-stock threshold, category, unit, and barcode. Drives low-stock notifications.

features.name: Invoices / Receipts
features.description: Create and manage invoices with line items, discount, tax, final amount, paid/remaining amounts (debt), linked to customers and products.
user_interactions: Create a new invoice with line items

features.name: Expenses & Profit
features.description: Track expenses by category and view profit. Can update settings (currency/exchange rate) from this view.

features.name: Debts & Repayments
features.description: Track outstanding customer debts and record repayments.

features.name: Reports & Analytics
features.description: Business reports and analytics generated from stored data, using user profile and settings.

features.name: Backup & Restore
features.description: Export/import business data for backup and restore; configurable backup interval and auto-backup.

features.name: Settings & License Activation
features.description: Manage store profile (name, owner, phone, address, logo), currency (IQD/USD), exchange rate, notifications, and license/activation.
user_interactions: Switch currency and set exchange rate
Enter activation code to activate license

features.name: AI Business Advisor (Iraqi)
features.description: Modal AI assistant powered by Google Gemini (@google/genai) that answers business questions in Iraqi Arabic dialect, contextualized to the store.
user_interactions: Open the advisor modal via floating button or nav

features.name: Free Trial & License Gate
features.description: New accounts get a 14-day free trial computed from createdAt. A banner shows remaining days; when the trial expires the app is blocked behind LicenseGateView until activated.
user_interactions: Click "تفعيل الآن" to go to activation
When expired, enter activation code on the license gate
Log out from the license gate

features.name: Owner / Admin Panel
features.description: Administrative panel accessible only to a hardcoded ADMIN_UID for managing users/licenses.
user_interactions: View/manage user accounts and licenses (admin only)

known_limitations.issue: App is a single-page app with tab state (activeTab) only, not URL routing. Deep-linking to a specific tab via URL is not supported.
known_limitations.impact: Tests cannot navigate directly by URL to a tab; they must log in then click nav buttons.

known_limitations.issue: Admin panel access is gated by a hardcoded ADMIN_UID constant, not a role from the backend.
known_limitations.impact: Only one specific Firebase UID can see/use the admin panel; not testable without that account.

known_limitations.issue: Authentication and all data persistence depend on live Firebase (Auth + Firestore) and require valid VITE_FIREBASE_* env vars and network/emulator access.
known_limitations.impact: Tests requiring login need valid test credentials; without them, only the login screen is reachable. Google sign-in uses a popup that automated tests typically cannot complete.

known_limitations.issue: AI advisor requires a valid Google Gemini API key.
known_limitations.impact: Advisor responses will fail without a configured Gemini key.

known_limitations.issue: Password reset (نسيت كلمة المرور؟) is not implemented — shows a coming-soon notice only.
known_limitations.impact: No functional password recovery flow to test.
